ground_truth_definition: Exact occasion, dress-code and style match plus encoded-sRGB Euclidean colour distance <= 155.

conditions.A_baseline: Weighted colour-distance and attribute score over all catalogue items; no hard filtering.
conditions.B_ontology_guided: SPARQL over the committed OGE ontology plus in-memory synthetic RDF facts filters exact occasion, dress-code and style constraints; remaining items use the same score and receive structured property-level traces.

interpretation_boundary: Deterministic synthetic benchmark only. Labels are generated from the same constructed fields used by the constraints. Results demonstrate implementation behaviour on this fixture; they do not establish real-world recommendation quality, user preference, generalisation, causal benefit or statistical significance.
